method: Constrained minimum squared-distance fit, nonnegative coefficients; partial effective flow response, not structural agent identification.
equation: withdrawal_proxy_pct[t+1] = c + beta * USDC_discount_pct[t] + rho * withdrawal_proxy_pct[t]
limitations: Invariant changes confound LP net flows, fees and A; no individual panic parameter, redemption delay or causal response is identified. Coefficients are not substituted into the ABM as if structurally calibrated.
